notes: Chart conditions: Exposure: 3200K Tungsten 1/50 sec; Process: ECN-2; Densitometry: ECN-2.

Fitted: the negative curves (gamma, toeExposure, toeWidth, shoulderExposure, shoulderWidth, per layer) to the neutral scale's dye amounts, computed from the digitized characteristic and spectral dye density charts (sha256 f0b637d7a6b080a2d15ecac63716db503a78de3a0662824d32ab3e8856d79f53, f4d27da1a8a9a8ef9f30027d9ea50fd45fa0f9c417fd3d223641c0888f6130d3) through ISO 5-3 Status M; and printingDensity, PD = P·c + b through SMPTE ST 2065-2 APD, fitted on the neutral scale (weighted 10) and a lattice of dye amounts.
Not stored: the fitted per-layer dye-amount offsets and the printing-density offset b (+0.0026, +0.0031, +0.0009); the calibrated printer lights absorb a constant per-layer density.

shoulderExposure lies -0.93, -0.39, -0.89 stops from the last traced sample (at +8.25 stops; negative = inside the traced range). The curve beyond the last traced sample, its flat top, is extrapolated.
Exposures are relative to mid-gray at log10 exposure -1.485 lux-seconds on the chart, an approximate anchor (see the fit report).

Print gamma rebalanced per channel to 1.3300 / (printingDensity · gamma): a print stock's layer contrasts are matched to the printing-density contrasts of the negatives it prints (SMPTE RP 180-1999 Introduction); without it the gray scale turns green/magenta away from mid-gray. The overall level, the product of print and negative contrast, is carried over from "Emulsion Default" and is artistic (MOV-5).
Hand-tuned, from "Emulsion Default": sensitivity, the print's minimum density, density range, shape and dyes, and the rendering choices.
fitResiduals: measured − fitted Status M density and dye amount per layer over the traced samples, and the printing-density matrix's residuals; they exclude the digitizing error.
